title: One and Done
text: One and Done. It seemed to work fine for the first week...but then after toasting just one item it would stop working for quite a long time, which meant I could not do another one in a decent amount of time. Maybe the thermostat was malfunctioning. I was using it with a quality 120v to 100v 1000w transformer, so whatever was happening had nothing at all to do with USA vs Japan power. The transformer was working perfectly, and I never used the Mitsubishi without the transformer.
